modern: Adapt yourself to the things among which your lot has been cast; and the men among whom you have received your portion, love them, but do it sincerely.
original: Adapt thyself to the things with which thy lot has been cast: and the men among whom thou hast received thy portion, love them, but do it truly [sincerely].
